Name: Guardians of Stardew Valley
Author: ForgedBrass
Description:
[b]What It Does[/b]
Adds in "Guardian Statues". These are custom statues that will provide the player with an item every morning that will help with that specific skill area.

[b]Statues Added [/b]
[list]
[*]Ancient Combat Statue
[/list][list]
[*]Ancient Mining Statue
[*]Ancient Fishing Statue
[*]Ancient Foraging Statue
[*]Ancient Farming Statue
[/list][spoiler]
[list]
[*]Ancient Luck Statue
[/list][/spoiler]

[b]How to Obtain Statues[/b]
[list]
[*]Ancient Combat Statue: [spoiler]Reach Level 5 in Combat and receive it in the mail the next day AND/OR buying from Marlon after year 1[/spoiler]
[*]Ancient Mining Statue: [spoiler]Reach Level 5 in Mining and receive it in the mail the next day AND/OR buying from The Dwarf after year 1[/spoiler]
[*]Ancient Fishing Statue: [spoiler]Reach Level 5 in Fishing and receive it in the mail the next day AND/OR buying from Willy after year 1[/spoiler]
[*]Ancient Foraging Statue: [spoiler]Reach Level 5 in Foraging and receive it in the mail the next day AND/OR buying from Robin after year 1[/spoiler]
[*]Ancient Farming Statue: [spoiler]Reach Level 5 in Farming and receive it in the mail the next day AND/OR buying from Pierre after year 1[/spoiler]
[/list][spoiler]Ancient Luck Statue: Reach Level 7 in [i]all[/i] skills and receive it in the mail the next day AND/OR buying from Krobus after year 1[/spoiler]
[b]
Items Statues Provide[/b]
[list]
[*]Ancient Combat Statue: [spoiler]Life Elixir, Crab Cakes, Fried Mushroom, Oil of Garlic, Mango Sticky Rice, Eggplant Parmesan[/spoiler]
[*]Ancient Mining Statue: [spoiler]Coal, Eggplant Parmesan, Maple Bar, Squid Ink Ravioli, Cranberry Sauce, Miner's Treat[/spoiler]
[*]Ancient Fishing Statue: [spoiler]Trout Soup, Chowder, Escargot, Dish O' The Sea, Lobster Bisque, Sea foam Pudding[/spoiler]
[*]Ancient Foraging Statue: [spoiler]Eggplant Parmesan, Field Snacks, Pancakes, Autumn's Bounty, Survival Burger, Tropical Curry[/spoiler]
[*]Ancient Farming Statue: [spoiler]Hash browns, Maple Bar, Pepper Poppers, Tom Kah Soup, Complete Breakfast, Farmer's Lunch[/spoiler]
[/list][spoiler]Ancient Luck Statue: [spoiler]Shrimp Cocktail, Spicy Eel, Banana Pudding, Ginger Ale, Pumpkin Soup, Lucky Lunch[/spoiler][/spoiler]
